title: Metrics endpoint
description: A Prometheus-format /metrics on an opt-in listener (metricsListen), read directly from the dogfood pod; no Prometheus server for now.
acceptanceCriteria: Every role serves /metrics on metricsListen; nothing listens when unset; the public port has none
Encode speed per running job, busy/total slots, jobs by kind, queue depth on workers
Segment wait histogram by source and play kind, stalls over 5 s, on stream
PlaybackInfo decisions by play method and refusals on api
Reaps, job outcomes, scan duration, Postgres pool stats
No title, path or unbounded value in any label
docs/running.md documents it and reading it with kubectl port-forward
notes: Option A chosen 2026-11-07: read /metrics directly; a small Prometheus beside jellyscale only if history is needed.
